baseline_frame: All 410 exact BL RNA specimens in the local registry; do not inherit plasma, untreated-disease or motor-endpoint membership.
population: Require native SC/BL PRIMDIAG=1 documented at/before RNA collection, with any contradictory pre-index code held. No future diagnoses. Report SWEDD recruitment separately and recommend excluding SWEDD in the main PD prognosis cohort; retain broader diagnosis-supported counts for transparent comparison. Genetic-cohort participants require the same native PD evidence. This population recommendation remains to be locked.
identity: One unique sample, participant and known identity component at baseline; missing or ambiguous mapping and multiple baseline samples per component are holds.
RNA: Require release pass, nonpool, technical_count_pass, metadata_numeric_valid and exact header/sample binding. RIN<6 and descriptive extreme flags are review flags, not newly invented exclusions. All selected raw counts must be finite nonnegative integers and match stored vector hashes.
timing: Strict month/year dates only; month index=year*12+month. Index is registry BL RNA collection month, confirmed by native BL Research_Biospecimens BLDDRDT with BLDRNA=1. Require baseline-reference agreement within one month using native BL start, otherwise unique dated unified BL reference with a flag. Participant-event linkage is not aliquot barcode proof. Use end-of-month conceptual landmark; within-month order unresolved.
baseline_selection: SC/BL dynamic assessments within prior three calendar months through RNA index; closest month, BL before SC, motor OFF before ON before unspecified, source row. Education uses latest nonfuture SC/BL without three-month restriction. Invalid supplied EXAMDT cannot silently use INFODT. Select before value QC. At the selected month/event/state conflicting relevant fields cause a hold or missing optional feature, never a more favourable replacement.
endpoints: Education-adjusted continuous MoCA at 12 [9,15], 24 [21,27], 36 [33,39] calendar months. Choose closest actual month, earlier month, event label, source row before value QC. Baseline MoCA mandatory. Audit SDMT and HVLT immediate/delayed follow-ups descriptively as potential supporting endpoints, not newly activated primary outcomes.

moca.primary: Education-adjusted continuous MoCA at 36 months, baseline MoCA included in later clinical comparator. Higher is better. No dichotomized fast/slow group, data-selected horizon or adjudicated PD-MCI claim.
moca.score: Require all 26 item scores integer and in range, sum 0..30. Add exactly one if pre-index EDUCYRS<=12 and sum<30; cap at 30. MCAVFNUM is a word count, never an item score.
moca.education_missing: Hold if education missing/invalid unless complete raw sum=30 (education-invariant ceiling). No inferred education from total score.
moca.total_reconciliation: If MCATOT present, accept only integer equal to raw item sum or education-adjusted sum; derive the corrected total once. Otherwise hold. If absent, complete item reconstruction is allowed and flagged.
moca.fluency: When a valid nonnegative integer MCAVFNUM is available, MCAVF must equal 1 if words>=11 else 0. Discordance creates a primary hold; keep original fields. Missing word count is flagged, not replaced.
secondary: 36-month HVLT immediate recall (three integer trials 0..12; sum 0..36)
moca.detailed_selection: For each instrument use its own INFODT and the same calendar window/tie rules; require a valid native SC/BL baseline score in the pre-index 3-month window. Preserve SDMTVRSN/HVLTVRSN; report same-form versus changed/unknown-form sensitivity. No global normalized T-score or learned composite.
moca.reliability: Keep item completeness, arithmetic concordance, ceiling, fluency and form flags. These are data consistency checks, not psychometric test-retest reliability estimates. Practice effects remain a limitation.
not_activated: New dementia/PD-MCI diagnosis from a MoCA threshold
Composite cognition learned on all participants
Time-to-event endpoint without adjudicated sustained events
Additional horizons selected from observed gains

enhanced: Require valid baseline SDMT, HVLT immediate and delayed recall and native form codes (SDMT 1..2, HVLT 1..6). Core-versus-enhanced comparisons must use this same matched cohort. Core optional-feature missingness is recorded and does not exclude otherwise eligible people; imputation is deferred to training.
sex: Audit pre-index SC/BL native SCREEN sex 0=female,1=male. Also record unified BL SEX availability as static corroboration, not automatic replacement or a plasma-linked annotation gate.
death: Hold baseline or assessment strictly after documented death month; flag same-month death; conflicting documented dates hold outcomes. WDDT/WDDEATH is withdrawal reporting, not an exact death date. No death-as-zero, outcome imputation or assumed follow-up completeness.
CBC: Audit historical measured CBC coverage and its lag from RNA only. Never import prior globally standardized CBC z-scores. A new CBC validity/selection contract is needed before a sensitivity model.
selection_exposure: Carry historical diagnostic discovery and prior clinical outcome-exposure indicators; no new folder/split restores untouched data.
permitted: Local source reconciliation, endpoint arithmetic, availability and QA. No model fitting, prediction, gene-outcome testing, paid queries, cloud calls or changes to prior files.
